info.title: AgentMemory
info.description: Persistent graph-backed agent memory over Neo4j. Recalls prior knowledge before a turn and persists new knowledge after it, across sessions and process restarts.

post.description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint exposing the AgentMemory tool surface: memory_search, memory_get_context, memory_store_message, memory_add_entity, memory_add_preference and the entity, reasoning, conversation and maintenance tools.

api_key.name: Authorization
api_key.description: Bearer token forwarded to the MCP host. The host is NOT authenticated by default — see the README before exposing it beyond a private network.
